as: a solo developer working with coding agents
want: the agent to start each session from one file that states the whole project state
so: I do not re-explain context or discover stale assumptions mid-task
criteria: STATUS.md is generated from the records and never hand-edited
CLAUDE.md names it as the first file to read

want: records that cannot quietly grow past their budget
so: the harness stays cheaper than the value it returns
criteria: Budgets live in harness.json and are enforced by harness-lint
Exceeding a budget fails the final gate

want: a done task to be a checkable claim
so: I can trust the journal without re-reading every task file
criteria: A done task has a journal line, no unchecked acceptance criterion, and its profile trace

want: to install the harness with one command
so: adoption is not a manual checklist I can get wrong
criteria: harness-init installs into a target directory
The result passes harness-status then harness-lint
Existing files are never overwritten without --force

as: a small team or multiple agent families
want: the team profile to be enforced, not merely described
so: traces and validation are real gates
criteria: Under team, a task past ready requires a trace file
Under team, a done task requires a named validator
